review_method: The sanitized facts, ruling date, base HTSUS holding, stated base rate, and status fields were checked against the official CBP CROSS API record. Target ruling identifiers were also checked against the application's searchable ruling cache.
reviewer_role: Codex source-verification review; not a licensed customs broker or legal opinion

cases.subject: The tariff classification of a double-walled vacuum sealed stainless-steel tumbler from China
cases.classification_basis: Laboratory-confirmed double-walled vacuum-insulated vessel with capacity below one liter.

cases.subject: The tariff classification of the Aspen tumbler from China
cases.classification_basis: Laboratory-confirmed double-wall vacuum outer vessel with capacity below one liter.

cases.subject: Protest 3001-98-100282; Vacuum Sealed Stainless Steel Drinkware
cases.classification_basis: Headquarters held that the vacuum-sealed vessel retained heat for a reasonable period despite its vented lid.

cases.subject: The tariff classification of travel mugs from China
cases.classification_basis: The isolated plastic-interior style was double-walled but laboratory testing found no vacuum insulation.

cases.subject: The tariff classification of a stainless steel single wall growler from China
cases.classification_basis: Single-wall stainless-steel household beverage vessel without vacuum insulation.

cases.subject: The tariff classification of insulated stainless steel beverage tumblers from China
cases.classification_basis: CBP classified the partially evacuated, uncased stainless-steel tumbler as stainless household ware in the ruling-date schedule.

cases.subject: The tariff classification of a stainless-steel vacuum vessel from China
cases.classification_basis: Laboratory-confirmed vacuum between sealed steel walls and capacity below one liter.

cases.subject: The tariff classification of a plastic planter from China
cases.classification_basis: Under GRI 3(b), the plastic planter supplied the composite article's essential character and primary household function.

cases.subject: The tariff classification of a plastic planter from China
cases.classification_basis: Under GRI 3(b), resin supplied the composite planter's bulk and essential character.

cases.subject: The tariff classification of plastic planter saucers from China
cases.classification_basis: Reusable plastic household article designed to capture water beneath a planter; conditional 9817 treatment is outside the eval target.

cases.subject: The tariff classification of a plastic planter from China
cases.classification_basis: Polypropylene household planter; conditional 9817 treatment is outside the eval target.

cases.subject: The tariff classification of a fiberglass reinforced plastic planter from China
cases.classification_basis: Fiberglass-reinforced plastic planter performing a household plant-holding function.

cases.subject: The tariff classification of ornamental plastic illuminated snowmen from China
cases.classification_basis: Under GRI 3(b), the plastic figure supplied the essential character and retained its primary ornamental function without illumination.

cases.subject: The tariff classification of a plastic ornamental wine glass badge from Taiwan
cases.classification_basis: CBP treated the silicone wine-glass badge as an ornamental article of plastic.

cases.subject: The tariff classification of a ceramic-handled cup, a ballpoint pen, and a miniature plastic ball from China
cases.classification_basis: The isolated component is porcelain, suitable for drink contact, and shaped as a handled cup rather than a tariff mug.

cases.subject: The tariff classification of a bone china tumbler with a silicone plastic lid
cases.classification_basis: Bone-china tableware above the specified value threshold; double walls do not create a vacuum vessel.

cases.subject: The tariff classification of a stoneware ceramic mug from China
cases.classification_basis: Non-porcelain stoneware vessel with the straight-sided proportions and handle of a tariff mug.

cases.subject: The tariff classification of a ceramic stoneware cup from China
cases.classification_basis: Tapered non-porcelain handled cup, not a tariff mug, valued over $5.25 per dozen.

cases.subject: The tariff classification of ceramic dolomite drinking vessels from China
cases.classification_basis: Tapered dolomite cups suitable for food or drink contact; neither mug treatment nor festive treatment applied.

cases.subject: The tariff classification of two ceramic cups from China
cases.classification_basis: Dolomite handled drinking cup, other than porcelain, valued over $5.25 per dozen.
